prompt:
REFINE PASS. The input image is already a finished photorealistic interior render, not an original old-room photograph.

Keep everything already in the image unchanged: same architecture, same wall planes and openings, same ceiling height, same floor level, same furniture, same materials, colours, lighting and shadows, same camera position, perspective, framing and aspect ratio. Do not move, remove, replace or resize anything.

Only add small decorative layers sitting on existing surfaces: potted plants and greenery, framed wall art, stacked books and magazines, ceramics and vases, candles, woven baskets, layered textiles (throws, cushions, rugs), small tabletop objects and small table lamps.

Every addition must stay small and secondary. Do not block doorways, window openings or walkways. Do not introduce large furniture, cabinets, built-in storage or structural elements.

Requested details: Add a large potted monstera and a table lamp.

The existing interior style is mid-century modern; any added decor must match it.

REALISM
Shot as an editorial interior photograph for a design magazine: 35 mm full-frame body, 24 mm tilt-shift kept level, natural imperfect surfaces - fabric wrinkles, curtain folds that are not perfectly symmetrical, faint scuffs on the skirting, real dust-free but lived-in tabletops, subtle sensor grain, gentle highlight rolloff. No retouching sheen, no HDR, no CGI, no archviz, no perfectly uniform material, no flawless symmetry, no plastic reflections.

Horizontal 4:3 composition.

The result must look like the same photograph with a few small objects added, not a re-rendered new space.
